# `omapac-repo snapshot cut`

- **Usage:** `omapac-repo snapshot cut <FLAGS>`

Copy a synced mirror into a new snapshot and point edge at it

## Flags
- **`--from <FROM>`** — The synced mirror: <from>/<repo>/os/<arch>/<repo>.db
- **`--id <ID>`** — The snapshot id; defaults to the current hour in UTC
- **`--opr-index <OPR_INDEX>`** — The OPR index this snapshot goes with, for its sequence
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
